name: Elisa Castaldi
summary: Associate Professor at the University of Florence. Her work addresses numerical cognition, visual perception, developmental dyscalculia, neuroimaging and plasticity of the visual system.
research: Her research investigates the perceptual and neural bases of numerical cognition and visual processing, with attention to development, atypical trajectories and experience-dependent plasticity.

teaching.text: Teaching information is maintained on the official University of Florence profile and course catalogue.

cv: Research on numerical cognition, visual perception and developmental dyscalculia.
Faculty member of Florence MAPLab and PisaVisionLab.
topics: Current themes include visual and numerical plasticity, developmental dyscalculia, individual differences in mathematical cognition and neuroimaging of perceptual systems.
